description: A fix brief, rendered and written to the run directory, with the preflight and the baseline it was made after. Nothing was sent to a model, to the forge or to git.

brief_path.description: The brief, brief.md in the run directory, as an absolute path.

prefix_sha256.description: The hex SHA-256 of the prefix of the brief. It is the same for two briefs over the same report and the same tree, whatever the run, the answers or the brain.

base.description: The branch the fix is made on.

base_head.description: The full hash of the commit of the base, which HEAD must still be at when the change is measured.

baseline.description: The gate on the tree as it was, or null when it was not measured.

gate_id.description: The id of the gate run, under .agent-fox/gate/.

passed.description: False when a check already fails before any change.

table.description: The table of checks of the gate, which is pinned for the run.

source.description: Where the table came from: gate.json, the Makefile or the language manifests.

available.description: Whether the program of the check can be run on this machine.

submit_argv.description: The command that submits the fix report of this run, which takes the report as JSON on stdin.
